## Before you create your first track.

Quick answers about free generations, commercial use, Instrument DNA, downloads, and how the studio works.

Ksumiyo is an AI music studio that turns prompts, moods, stories, and sound choices into finished tracks. It combines text-to-music with producer-level controls for genre, tempo, duration, drums, bass, melody, harmony, and atmosphere.

Ksumiyo currently offers a free daily generation limit so creators can test the studio and make tracks. Limits, account features, and paid plans may change as the service grows.

Ksumiyo is designed for creator and commercial projects, including videos, podcasts, games, films, ads, and social content. Usage is subject to the Terms and Music Rules, and you should keep a record of your prompt and Track DNA for important projects.

Ksumiyo is built around a royalty-free creator workflow. That generally means you can use generated tracks without ongoing per-play royalties, subject to the Music Rules and any restrictions in the Terms.

Instrument DNA is Ksumiyo's control layer for shaping the music before generation. You can guide drums, bass, melody, harmony, atmosphere, genre, BPM, and duration instead of relying only on a text prompt.
